criterion: Give a design choice with a concrete reason tied to the user's needs. For requested reasons, accept grounded reasons or a plain explanation of why the available facts give no basis for one.
prompt: We have 30 households borrowing garden tools at the hall. We have settled on paper-only signups and loan records, no deposits and volunteers on Saturday mornings. Design checkout within those choices, and give reasons.

samples.answer: Use numbered paper checkout cards so Saturday volunteers can match each borrowed garden tool to the household that has it.
Use numbered paper checkout cards. They are the best design.
Use a shared spreadsheet because two desk volunteers need to see the same loans at once.
